description: This Java class 'ProtectViewWorker' handles access control for web views by implementing protection logic such as rate limiting and tarpit (delaying or blocking access) based on user interactions with specific views. It manages hit counts, tarpit timing, and checks for user-specific view restrictions within a web application.

classes.name: ProtectViewWorker
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to enforce view protection rules based on user activity and rate limiting.

methods.name: checkProtectedView
methods.description: Checks if a user is allowed to access a particular view, implementing rate limiting and tarpit logic based on previous access patterns and defined thresholds.
